notes: Sheet east of Burnet: Burnet Avenue ('BURNET AV.', 50', 6 in. pipe) down the west side; Helen ('HELEN', 50', 6 in. pipe) across the top from Burnet to a T on Reading Road; Reading Road ('READING R'D', 70', 20 in. W.P.) runs SSE through the middle; McGregor Avenue ('McGREGOR AV.', 60' west of Reading, 55'/50' east of it) crosses the sheet. 'McGREGOR PL.' (32', 6 in. pipe) runs south from McGregor Avenue to the bend of Ryan Avenue. 'RYAN AV.' (50') comes in from Reading Road ENE-WSW, turns due south at (1403,3640) and runs south past Earnshaw onto sheet 175. McGregor Place's mouth opens into the inside of that bend (open area x ~1135-1493, y ~3600-3815); the McGregor Place/Ryan Avenue point is where McGregor Place's centreline meets Ryan's ENE centreline extended, inside that open area. The bottom street is printed 'ERNSHAW' (50'), but the block-face labels read both 'ERNSHAW' and 'EARNSHAW'; it is the same street as sheet 184's 'EARNSHAW', so it is named Earnshaw Street (misprint noted). Earnshaw runs from the left edge across Burnet and ends at Ryan (Ryan's east line is unbroken). 'IOWA AV. (IRWIN PL.)' (50') crosses McGregor: north of McGregor it runs to the top edge toward sheet 194 (Iowa Av. (Irwin)); south of McGregor it ends at a diagonal lot line. Dover ('DOVER', 50') leaves McGregor southward and stops at y ~2200; a second 50 ft strip labelled 'DOVER.' starts just south-west of it and runs SSE off the drawn area toward sheet 176's Dover; both stubs are recorded as ends. 'WILKINSON' (50', 4 in. pipe) runs east from the diagonal tract boundary across Fowler toward sheet 186. 'FOWLER' (30') runs from the top edge (north of Wilkinson, 4 in. pipe) south across Wilkinson and McGregor to the street at y 3409-3585; Monroe (label 'MONROE' at the right edge, block lines y 2452/2627, ~50 ft) and that bottom street leave Fowler's east side; the bottom street is unlabelled here and is named Manitou Street from sheet 186 and the key map ('MANITOU'). Fowler ends at Manitou (its west line stops at Manitou's south line, where the 'B' dash-dot section line starts). Wilkinson, Fowler, Monroe, Manitou and Dover are printed without a suffix and named Street per convention. The 'C ... D' dash-dot line at y ~600 east of Reading is a section line, not a street. North of McGregor between Reading and Wilkinson the sheet shows the sheet 194 tract outline only; no other streets. No alleys. McGregor jogs slightly at Iowa: west of Iowa it is ~55-60 ft (lines y ~1585/1768, centre ~1676), east of it ~50 ft (lines y ~1550/1722, centre ~1636); the Iowa crossing point is the centre of the open crossing.
